source: Yahoo Finance daily bars (chart API; yfinance fallback). Price returns, not total return. Market cap / EV from Yahoo quoteSummary, converted to EUR.

method.returns: Last close vs last close on/before the same calendar date N periods earlier; YTD vs prior year-end close; n/a if history is shorter.
method.volume: Last session volume vs average of the N sessions before it.
method.ma: Simple moving average of daily closes incl. the latest bar; % = price / MA - 1.
method.futures: Futures: one explicit contract month (e.g. Brent Jan-27, Yahoo BZF27.NYM) for the price, 1D to 1Y changes, moving averages and the 1Y line, so every change compares the same month. The month is the one still trading after today's session (on an expiry day the next month is used for both dates). 2Y to 10Y come from Yahoo's continuous front-month series and include roll effects. If the contract quote is missing, the continuous level is shown without any change.
method.mcap_ev: Yahoo marketCap. Equity EV = market cap + net debt (latest total debt minus cash & short-term investments) + minority interest, reporting-currency balance sheet converted at current FX (same as the company panel); Yahoo enterpriseValue only when components are missing (and for ETFs). Converted to EUR via Yahoo EUR{CCY}=X (ECB SDW mid fallback). London quotes are in pence (GBp); Yahoo market cap is in GBP (checked against shares x price, a 100x pence slip is scaled back).
method.last_close: When Yahoo's chart API leaves the latest daily close blank (common for Nordic/LSE tickers), the quote's regularMarketPrice for that session is used (last_from_quote).
method.prices: Latest price = Yahoo quote (regularMarketPrice / regularMarketTime; typically ~15 min delayed, not live); 1D vs the previous session's close. While a session is open the latest daily bar (and its volume) is today so far.
